  • news.management.commands.seed_demo

news.management.commands.seed_demo

The seed_demo management command, which creates local demo data.

Run it with python manage.py seed_demo. The demo accounts share a known password and must only be used for local testing.

Classes

Command

Create demo reader, editor, and journalist accounts and sample content.

Functions

get_or_create_demo_user

Create or reset a demo user with the given role and the demo password.

Details

news.management.commands.seed_demo.DEMO_PASSWORD = 'DemoPass123!'

Password shared by every demo account. For local testing only.

news.management.commands.seed_demo.get_or_create_demo_user(username, role, email)[source]

Create or reset a demo user with the given role and the demo password.

Parameters:

  • username (str) – The demo account’s username.

  • role (str) – A value from news.models.User.Roles.

  • email (str) – Email address used when the account is first created.

Returns:

The saved demo user.

Return type:

news.models.User

class news.management.commands.seed_demo.Command(stdout=None, stderr=None, no_color=False, force_color=False)[source]

Bases: BaseCommand

Create demo reader, editor, and journalist accounts and sample content.

The command is safe to run more than once: existing demo records are reused rather than duplicated.
